r.s: Class for parsing and handling URL.
r.d: Provides parsing of URLs into their constituent parts (scheme, host, path etc.), URL generation, and resolving of relative URLs.
r.n: * Fix: Remove executable bit on *.php files * Fix: libpcre2 10.45 compat: _encodeData \x shorthand for \x00 (Request #29032) * Fix: PHP 8.4 compat: URL2: Make $array non optional in _queryArrayByBrackets (Bug #28649) * Imp: Update CI to GitHub Actions * Imp: Exclude dev files from Composer package
